note: Behavioural parity evals. They test V1 sequence, source access, human ownership and study boundaries without prescribing an aesthetic, direction count, composition or concept vocabulary.

evals.prompt: Here is our brief and a set of visual references. Explore meaningfully different directions before we build anything.
evals.expected_output: A reference-first study that keeps the original sources available, explores before formalising, builds narrow proofs and stops for a human decision.
expectations: Opens and studies the original references before proposing directions.
Uses notes and source responsibilities as aids, never as replacements for the originals.
Proposes directions before freezing contracts or completing provenance records.
Builds only the smallest proofs needed to compare the directions.
Reviews similarity and provenance after the proofs exist.
Ends at STUDY — DECISION REQUIRED.

evals.prompt: Explore alternatives, then pick one, repair it and tell me when it is ready to ship.
evals.expected_output: The study recommends but does not select for the person, create a production system, repair production work or declare readiness.
expectations: Does not create production tokens or revise the production design system.
Does not run a production repair pass.
Does not report READY, READY WITH PROPOSALS or REVIEWED.
Leaves selection to the person and names the handoff to /design-build.

evals.prompt: Use these references for composition, type behaviour and motion respectively. Explore directions for our real content.
evals.expected_output: The sources inform bounded responsibilities while remaining directly visible to the designer; they are not averaged into generic taste language or mapped to a starter.
expectations: Records what each reference contributes and what must not transfer.
Keeps the originals available during synthesis and proof-building.
Does not open a starter or stock structure catalogue.
Explains major decisions after exploration through brief, content, function or reference responsibility.

evals.prompt: Explore some options for this brief. I have not specified how many or what they should look like.
evals.expected_output: The number and form of directions follow the brief and evidence rather than a built-in default or house style.
expectations: Does not force a fixed number of directions.
Does not require a named visual mechanism, stock archetype or standard page skeleton.
Rejects options that differ only by palette or ornament.
Lets the proof form follow what each direction needs to demonstrate.

evals.prompt: None of these directions is right. Reject all of them and try again from the brief and references.
evals.expected_output: Reject-all is accepted as a normal human verdict and the next study restarts from the original brief and sources rather than salvaging fragments.
expectations: Records that every direction was rejected.
Does not force a winner or combine rejected fragments.
Offers a rerun from the original evidence and the person's feedback.

evals.prompt: Build the page from these references.
evals.expected_output: Single-contract mode forms one provisional reference-led direction and returns it to /design-build, while offering a study when the evidence has materially different readings.
expectations: Studies the original references before forming the direction.
Freezes the contract only after the direction is proposed.
Hands /design-build the contract, original assigned references and real assets.
Does not silently choose when several materially different directions are equally plausible.

evals.prompt: Study this one site so I can understand why it works.
evals.expected_output: A read-only single-source study that treats fetched content as data and stops without building or mapping the source to a starter.
expectations: Uses the single-source study route.
Declares what could and could not be inspected.
Does not create a starter, production page or readiness verdict.
Ends at STUDY — DECISION REQUIRED.

evals.prompt: Closely recreate the layout and motion of this reference; we have permission and that is the brief.
evals.expected_output: The explicit request enables reference-directed mode while recording allowed resemblance and non-transferable identity elements.
expectations: Enables reference-directed mode only because the person explicitly requested it.
Records what may be followed closely and what must not transfer.
Runs the similarity review after the proof and judges it against those recorded limits.

evals.prompt: Two project entries have no screenshots. Explore portfolio directions without inventing work.
evals.expected_output: Missing assets remain explicit gaps and are not replaced by fabricated interfaces or evidence.
expectations: Separates verified project evidence from missing assets.
Does not invent dashboards, screenshots or device mockups.
Uses honest text-only or labelled placeholders where needed.
Carries the asset limits into the proofs and comparison.

evals.prompt: I selected direction B but want to reduce the colour while preserving its interaction idea.
evals.expected_output: The accepted change is an amendment to the frozen direction rather than a rewrite of its history.
expectations: Keeps the base contract read-only.
Records what changed, what was preserved and the person's reason.
Hands the base contract and accepted amendment to /design-build.

evals.prompt: I want to create a professional landing page for an AI workshop and education portal. I don’t have brand guidelines, but I’ve attached examples I like. Study them and first give me three design directions to choose from. Use the design skills in this kit for direction and review.
evals.expected_output: A reference-first study with native packaged skill calls, proof-safe craft guidance, independent visual reviews and an honest human decision stop. Human judgement of rendered originality remains primary.
expectations: Invokes packaged direction-study through Claude Code Skill tool without requiring the user to name it; reading SKILL.md alone fails.
Opens supplied original screenshots and keeps them directly visible through exploration and proof-building; attach actual user references when executing this definition.
Develops three directions because the user requested three, checks divergence, then freezes minimal contracts; no starter catalogue or external frontend-design.
Invokes packaged ui-design-principles study-proof for each proof; uses quick-rules as index and relevant detailed rules.md sections at decisions, with decision/section evidence.
Invokes packaged distinctiveness-review independently for every rendered proof with brief, original references, contract and render, no builder preference or other conclusions.
Writes first visual judgement before detector and read-only UI scan evidence; keeps their limitations visible.
Compares reference resonance, imitation/similarity, genericness and mechanical quality independently; resonance cannot hide genericness.
Confirmed genericness/AI-default construction receives no positive recommendation; missing reviews block recommendation; may reject all.
IA Mode 3 runs only for material unresolved structure needed to test a direction; no production system work or compulsory full page.
Preserves original failed evidence during any versioned exploration rerun, repeats reviews and stops for human decision.

Checks the transcript-derived study-orchestration.json receipt with scripts/check-orchestration.py and audits Skill calls/origins against the actual transcript; structural PASS does not certify taste.
Test separately in Claude Code project mode and installed Cowork plugin mode; verify native activation and authenticated payload, never assume folder selection registers skills.
Creates local HTML proofs by default and does not use Claude Design or another canvas without an explicit user request.
New imagery, text-over-image or motion decisions in later rounds reopen the relevant detailed rules; prior user approval records intent without waiving correctness.
Before proposing directions, reuses supplied answers or asks one bundled discovery for loose/rearranged/close influence, gated reference traits and imagery permission; waits for material answers.
Records 3–5 concrete observed traits per original and dated actual human approval for gated traits; study approval does not require production DESIGN.md or authorize accessibility defects.
Plans imagery per direction; approved labelled generated placeholders or proposed UI are allowed, while verified claims are never fabricated. No silent shared-image pool or type-only fallback.
Every reference visibly leads or contributes somewhere, or its omission has human confirmation.

Reference reviewer observes actual originals and saves defining traits before seeing builder contracts; checks at least two structural changes from the lead source unless close recreation was explicitly authorized.
Treats absence of familiar slop markers and a zero detector count as insufficient evidence of quality; reports visible lost influence, genericness and sample-content inconsistencies.
